allOf.$comment: R10.1 - assignments are meaningless without roles and vice versa.
R10.2/R10.9 - rotation pulls in the whole apparatus and is L2 only.
R10.4 - waves reference groups, groups own modules.
R10.8 - a declared corridor implies a wave structure to protect.
R10.15/R10.16 - cyclic rotation pulls in the same apparatus and is L2 only.
R10.24 - indefinite repeat requires an open end and a drain plan.
R10.24 - open_ended is meaningless without a null duration.
R10.21 - a looping show needs looping roles.
spec 2 - content_hash and signature are OPTIONAL at L0/L1 and REQUIRED at L2.
S10.9 - rotation members MUST be absent at L0/L1.
spec 7.6 - disarmed fall containment is a REQUIRED, checkable field at L2
R10.10 - rotation declares its ground service capacity.
R10.11 - a swap policy declares its battery pool.
